activation: requires new source installation; never reclassify old Other records
unknown_policy: unsupported enum is a counted observation gap, never Other or success
missing_or_unclassified_rate: cardinality of union(unique(attempt_id, stage) with Other OR missing OR unsupported reason) / all unique(attempt_id, stage) discard observations in the same scope; null when denominator zero or scopes differ; count each key once
